hashes: sha256 of the file bytes, except datos/clases.tif and the rasters written here: content hash (severidad.calculo.content_hash; dtype, shape, CRS, transform and pixels), because GeoTIFF compression gives different bytes on Windows and Linux

built_up.resampling: nearest neighbour from 10 m to the grid of datos/clases.tif
built_up.use: reference outline on the maps only; no figure is computed with it

relief: hillshade, azimuth 315, altitude 45, vertical exaggeration 1.5; 0 = no data
